deadline.value: The Graduate School lists a December 1 deadline (2026 for Fall 2027), fall only; the deadline is absolute and incomplete applications are not fully considered.
deadline.quote: Biomedical Engineering (614800) ... MSE, Ph.D. Fall only; Dec. 1

also.quote: The deadline is absolute, and we cannot grant extensions due to the condensed timeline of the admission process.

gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not considered in the admissions process.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Recommended (not strict minimum) scores: TOEFL 100+, Duolingo 135+, IELTS 7.0+.
toefl_min.quote: Recommended scores are 100 or greater on the TOEFL, 135 or greater on the Duolingo English Test, and 7.0 or greater on the IELTS.

supervisor.value: Direct Admit: after an interview weekend, faculty choose applicants for their labs; admission comes with a confirmed advisor.
supervisor.quote: At UT Austin BME, we use a Direct Admit process to match Ph.D. applicants with faculty advisors during admissions. | After the event, faculty select applicants they wish to directly admit into their research group.

funding.value: Matched PhD students receive a full funding package with admission (about 95% of doctoral students have full support), subject to funds and progress.
funding.quote: Matched students receive admission to the Ph.D. program, a full funding package and a confirmed spot in a faculty lab.

also.quote: The vast majority of doctoral students—approximately 95%—receive full financial support through teaching assistantships, graduate research assistantships or a variety of UT Austin and external fellowships.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in a field compatible with biomedical engineering is enough; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Doctoral applicants should possess a bachelor’s degree in an area compatible with the field of biomedical engineering. | A master’s degree is not required to apply.

notes: Spring doctoral entry only by faculty nomination. The admissions page still describes the 'fall 2026' cycle.
